answer: The ledger escrows every young account's rewards and sets vesting at one day per 50 newcomers network-wide. Unvested tokens get no haven, because a fraud proof burns them. An agent earning 30 tokens a day booking wharf berths vests in 10 days in a 500-agent cohort. The n-th fake adds 0.02 days to all n farm accounts, freezing about 0.6n more token-days. Elapsed time can't be reset, shared or run in parallel, so a cheap sybil farm becomes a fable.
